title: Input ledger of one knowledge pass (artifacts/<product>/knowledge/coverage.json, or knowledge/modules/<m>/coverage.json), written only by scripts/knowledge.mjs (D-051)

runId.description: The run that last rebuilt this pass's ledger.

items.description: Every configured input (requirement_doc, reference, module_reference) and every other source the pass recorded (extra, live-product). A configured input is mapped (read), excluded (reason failed|excluded) or pending; an extra source over the cap is deferred (reason budget).

id.description: The normalized location (URL or repo path).

verified.description: Stamped by knowledge.mjs check when the pass passed: the sha256 of the pass's files (product: overview, openPoints and glossaryRows, the digest of the product-scope glossary rows; module: overview, glossary, notes, sources, openPoints). The stage's done refuses a missing or stale stamp.
